question: List CTLA-4 trials that reported composite or co-primary endpoints.

gemini.answer: This SQL query returns the NCT, author, year, pubmed ID, trial name, cancer type, ICI name, ICI class, primary endpoint, and primary endpoint description for all trials using CTLA-4 inhibitors that reported composite or co-primary endpoints.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"trial_name\", \"cancer_type\", \"ici_name\", \"ici_class\", \"primary_endpoint\", \"primary_endpoint_is_multiple_or_composite\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"ici_class\" = 'CTLA-4' AND \"primary_endpoint_is_multiple_or_composite\" IS NOT NULL;","answer":"This SQL query returns the NCT, author, year, pubmed ID, trial name, cancer type, ICI name, ICI class, primary endpoint, and primary endpoint description for all trials using CTLA-4 inhibitors that reported composite or co-primary endpoints.","assumptions":""}
